title: sonchus arvensis subsp. humilis
intro: Sonchus arvensis subsp. humilis, commonly known as field sowthistle, is a subspecies of the Sonchus arvensis plant, which is a type of thistle that belongs to the dandelion family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Sonchus arvensis subsp. humilis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
